description: This file generates a student monthly attendance report, including attendance status, holidays, and leave applications, for an educational ERP system.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates the column headers for the attendance report based on days in the month.

methods.name: get_students_list
methods.description: Extracts a list of student identifiers from the students object.

methods.name: get_attendance_list
methods.description: Retrieves and maps attendance data for students between specified dates.

methods.name: get_students_with_leave_application
methods.description: Fetches leave applications for students within date range and maps leave days.

methods.name: daterange
methods.description: Generator that yields dates between two given dates.

methods.name: mark_holidays
methods.description: Marks holiday dates in the attendance map for students.
